title: Mining Workflow Graphs for Black-Box Boundary Testing of Conversational LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2607.06873v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Failures of conversational LLM agents can have real-world consequences, for example when an agent completes a transaction without the user's confirmation. An important class of such failures occurs at workflow boundaries, such as identity checks and confirmation steps, which a test can reach only after several turns of conversation. We present AgentEval, a black-box testing framework that discovers and tests these boundaries. AgentEval interacts with an agent to mine a conversational workflow graph, a model of its behavior whose nodes are the agent's activities and whose edges are the user actions observed between them. It generates tests at each node of this graph, replaying the conversational path to that node before applying a perturbation. translated_title: 挖掘工作流图用于对话式LLM智能体的黑盒边界测试
translated_abstract: 对话式LLM智能体的故障可能产生现实世界的影响，例如智能体在未经用户确认的情况下完成交易。这类故障的一个重要类别发生在工作流边界处，例如身份验证和确认步骤，而测试只有在经过多轮对话之后才能到达这些边界。我们提出了AgentEval，一个用于发现并测试这些边界的黑盒测试框架。AgentEval与智能体进行交互，以挖掘出一个对话工作流图——这是对智能体行为的建模，其中节点表示智能体的活动，边表示在这些活动之间观察到的用户操作。它在该图的每个节点处生成测试，在施加扰动之前先重放到达该节点的对话路径。随后AgentEval运行每个测试，并由一个独立的LLM裁判仅根据对话轮次来判断测试通过与否。我们将AgentEval与一个拥有特权的白盒审计器进行了基准对比……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了AgentEval黑盒测试框架，通过与智能体交互挖掘其对话工作流图，并在各节点重放对话路径后施加扰动，从而系统性发现并测试身份验证、确认步骤等工作流边界处的故障。
en_tdlr: AgentEval, a black-box testing framework that mines conversational workflow graphs from LLM agents and generates perturbation tests at each node to uncover failures at workflow boundaries such as identity checks and confirmation steps.
